title: Certifying Distributionally Robust Decisions from Projection Observations
abstract: arXiv:2610.34493v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A scalar measurement can determine a robust decision without identifying the latent covariance or every decision risk. We study finite Gaussian projection experiments with a fixed mean-plus-standard-deviation target. The observation laws define a set of indistinguishable moment models. We exhibit decisions that agree throughout that set despite unidentified risk values, and give a confidence-set certificate that returns a decision or an unresolved outcome. We prove soundness, necessary abstention for indistinguishable models with incompatible optima, and a fixed-checkpoint certification guarantee. A scalar profile reduces nonlinear risk comparisons to convex inner problems. Across seven synthetic instances, jointly calibrated moment regions give sufficient budgets 21 to 52 times explicit expected-sample information lower bounds. translated_title: 从投影观测中认证分布鲁棒决策
translated_abstract: 标量测量能够在不识别潜在协方差或每个决策风险的情况下确定一个鲁棒决策。我们研究了具有固定“均值加标准差”目标的有限高斯投影实验。观测规律定义了一组不可区分的矩模型。我们展示了尽管风险值未被识别、但在该模型集合上保持一致的决策，并给出一种置信集证书，该证书返回一个决策或一个“未解决”的结果。我们证明了该方法的健全性、对于具有不相容最优解的不可区分模型的必要弃权，以及固定检查点的认证保证。一种标量轮廓方法将非线性风险比较简化为凸内问题。在七个合成实例中，联合校准的矩区域给出了比显式期望样本信息下界充足21至52倍的预算。单独测量的停止时间更低，并在1,900个模拟数据流中实现了零决策错误。这些结果……
tldr: 该论文提出一种置信集证书方法，仅凭标量投影观测即可在不识别潜在协方差与各决策风险的情况下认证分布鲁棒决策，并证明了其健全性、必要弃权条件与固定检查点认证保证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a confidence-set certificate that certifies distributionally robust decisions from scalar projection observations without identifying the latent covariance or decision risks, proving its soundness, necessary abstention, and fixed-checkpoint certification guarantee.
